failure_inclusive_stage_timing_demo.detail: 3 passed. StageTimer records successful and failed software wall time, preserves unavailable stages with reasons, and is used by the end-to-end isolated FastAPI demo across transfer, normalization/readback, extraction, drafting, verification, clinician approval and export. Recording, ASR and diarization are explicitly marked unavailable for the silent scripted fixture.

limitations: Measurements are from a scripted synthetic demo; they do not instrument production recording, transfer, normalization, ASR, diarization, review or export workers.
Recording, ASR and diarization are intentionally unavailable in the demo, so this does not complete stage timing across a real audio-to-note workflow.
Timing covers software wall time only and does not measure clinician active task time or hardware-equivalent performance.
